mapper.delete: DELETE FROM sys_role_permission WHERE role_id = #{roleId} AND permission_id = #{permissionId}
mapper.select: SELECT id, role_id AS roleId, permission_id AS permissionId FROM sys_role_permission WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, role_id AS roleId, permission_id AS permissionId FROM sys_role_permission WHERE role_id = #{roleId} AND permission_id = #{permissionId} LIMIT 1

WHERE rp.role_id IN
#{userRole.roleId}

ORDER BY p.id
